name: Microsoft Agent Framework
description: Microsoft's framework for building, orchestrating and deploying AI agents and multi-agent workflows in Python and .NET; the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen.

name: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)
description: Google's code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating and deploying AI agents.

name: Claude Agent SDK
description: Anthropic's SDK for building agents on the Claude Code agent loop (tools, sub-agents, MCP); published to PyPI as claude-agent-sdk.

name: DSPy
description: Stanford's framework for programming, not prompting, language models: declarative modules and optimizers for prompts and weights.

name: CAMEL
description: Open-source multi-agent framework for role-playing agent societies, data generation and agent scaling research.

name: BeeAI Framework
description: Framework for production-ready AI agents in Python and TypeScript (Linux Foundation / IBM BeeAI).

name: Genkit
description: Google Firebase's open-source framework for building AI-powered applications, with libraries for Node.js and Go (Go in alpha).

name: Dify
description: Open-source platform to build agentic workflows and RAG pipelines in a visual, collaborative workspace; self-hosted or Dify Cloud.
license: Dify Open Source License (Apache-2.0 based, with additional conditions)

name: Langflow
description: Visual low-code tool for building and deploying AI agents and workflows, with a Python runtime and API/MCP serving.
